headline: Saudi SHUTS 🛢️ Key OIL 🛢️ Pipeline After DRONE 🛸 Attack from IRAQ 🇮🇶
text:
Saudi Arabia 🇸🇦 has SLAMMED 🚪 shut a CRITICAL 🛠️ oil pipeline 🛢️ after it got absolutely POUNDED 💥 by DRONES 🛸 launched straight from IRAQ 🇮🇶 territory as the whole Middle East 🌍 conflict keeps WIDENING 📈 like a bad Tinder date gone nuclear ☢️!! Iraq admitted 🗣️ they fired a military commander 🎖️ and launched a full investigation 🔎 after confirming the drone attack 🛸 originated in one of their provinces right on the border with Iran 🇮🇷!! Saudi has previously called out Iran-backed 🧔‍♂️ militia groups in Iraq for repeatedly TARGETING 🎯 its precious oil facilities 🛢️ and now this East-West pipeline 🛢️ that stretches a whopping 1200km is helping the world's largest crude exporter 🚢 bypass the Strait of Hormuz altogether 🌊!! The incident hits right as Iranian-backed Houthi rebels ⚔️ make a massive advance in Yemen putting even MORE pressure on global oil shipping routes 🚚 as the US-Iran war stretches into its painful seventh month 📅 with everyone getting edged 😩 on the edge of disaster!!

On Friday the Saudi-backed Yemen government forces struck back hard 💥 at Houthi fighters in the strategic coastal city of Mokha just a day after the Houthis seized the entire Red Sea coast 🌊 locking down that vital waterway like a jealous ex 🥴!! Riyadh announced they shut the pipeline 🛢️ purely as a precaution after satellite images 📸 popped up showing scorched ground 🔥 and thick smoke billowing near the attack site like some apocalyptic backyard BBQ 🍖!! The foreign ministry confirmed the strike caused some injuries 🤕 and damage that is still being assessed with everyone holding their breath 😤 while crude oil prices barrel toward over 100 bucks a barrel 💰 for the first time since July!! Saudi has chosen not to retaliate yet following a direct call from Iraq's prime minister and instead they will support Iraqi government efforts to prevent future attacks from their soil 🏜️ while reserving the right to safeguard their sovereignty and citizens at any moment 👑!!

The Iraqi prime minister's office quickly removed the operations commander in the Maysan governorate which borders Iran after it was confirmed the drone attack 🛸 was launched from that exact region with the guy getting the boot 👢 faster than you can say oil crisis 🛢️!! Saudi Arabia has carried out strikes alongside the US before against those Iran-backed militias in Iraq after accusing them of launching similar drones at oil facilities in the past so this is basically round two of the same old desert drama 🏜️!! The Gulf Cooperation Council made up of Saudi the UAE Bahrain Oman Qatar and Kuwait dropped a strong statement condemning the attack as a dangerous escalation that threatens Saudi security territorial integrity and vital installations like a total violation of international law 📜 with secretary general Jasem Mohamed Albudaiwi sounding extra salty about the whole mess 😤!!

This week the lightning Houthi advance in Yemen has seen militants seize control of much of the country's coastline with the group claiming they now hold the Bab al-Mandab Strait gateway to the Red Sea and Suez Canal 🌊 though they swear maritime navigation stays safe for everyone except Saudi vessels 🚢 which is basically them flipping the bird 🖕 to Riyadh!! The Yemeni Armed Forces hit back on Friday with spokesman Majid al-Nuzaili announcing they targeted Houthi positions in and around Mokha destroying vehicles weapons and killing several fighters while the strategic coastal city sits about 80km north of that critical strait where the Houthis had just seized Mokha the day before causing masses of people to flee toward Aden where the recognized government chills 🏛️!! Local sources reported more government air strikes on Houthi forces in Taiz governorate along the Red Sea coast and neighboring Ibb governorate turning the whole area into a chaotic hot zone 🔥 with the UN warning at least 76000 people displaced since July and that number quadrupling in the past week alone 😱!!

Entire families are fleeing often at night with nowhere safe to go exhausted and stripped of resources most carrying nothing but the clothes on their backs the UN statement said painting a grim picture of a rapidly worsening displacement crisis unfolding by the hour in Yemen as both sides of the Arabian Peninsula get absolutely squeezed like a stress ball 🧘‍♂️!! These developments have pushed crude oil prices over 100 dollars a barrel for the first time since July sparking fresh inflation fears that are jacking up government borrowing costs while analysts like Richard Bronze from Energy Aspects warn that even before this the detour via Suez and around Africa was already adding 30 days to sailing times and hiking transport expenses through the roof 📈!! The buffers that helped manage the crisis are mostly gone so oil prices will keep rising if both situations continue with diesel markets already hitting record levels that will inflate costs for everything from manufacturing to transportation like a never-ending nightmare for consumers 🛒!! Unless the Middle East situation improves crude prices could return to the 120 per barrel peak from earlier in the Iran war or even climb higher according to the experts leaving the whole global economy holding its breath 😬 while Saudi stays cautious but ready to protect its facilities and people at all costs 🛡️!!
